title: Start the day and prioritise work
steps: Review overdue, promised callbacks and new lead deadlines.
Open a priority row to enter that prospect record.
Mark availability for allocation; this never changes the login role.
validation: Current active assignment is mandatory. Availability uses approved hours and absence status; it does not change ownership.
system: Load own tasks, lead counts and reminders with an as-of timestamp. Record availability changes with effective time.
report: My day shows operational workload. Personal performance keeps the historical team and role for each event.
exception: No active assignment: show access pending. A delayed provider shows a stale-data badge, not zero calls.

title: Filter, search and save a lead view
steps: Choose stage, due date, source and product filters.
Select Apply filters; view only owned results and permitted contact fields.
Save view with a name or Reset to the default inbox.
validation: Search, counts and suggestions must obey ownership scope. Saved views store filters, never a reusable copy of customer data.
system: Run a paginated scoped query. Store the employee-specific view definition and reapply current permissions each time.
report: Changing a filter changes the displayed slice only. It never changes lead attribution or report definitions.
exception: No match: show an empty state and Clear filters. Another caller lead ID returns no exposed customer information.

title: Open a prospect and inspect the full record
steps: Open a lead from the inbox or a valid notification.
Use Summary, Timeline, Tasks, Documents and Outcome tabs.
Select Call, WhatsApp or Add activity from the prospect header.
validation: The opportunity must belong to the current permitted workload. Contact links expose only enquiries the caller may see.
system: Fetch opportunity and scoped related records. Show provenance, ownership history, permissions and outstanding tasks.
report: Viewing a record is not a contact activity and adds no sales credit. Sensitive document access is separately audited.
exception: Reassigned while open: show a read-only access-changed message, clear sensitive fields and return to the inbox.

title: Correct prospect information
steps: Select Edit details from the prospect record.
Update allowed fields and explain the correction.
Save changes; protected identity changes go to verification or a review queue.
validation: Validate phone/email format and possible duplicate identity. Caller cannot change source attribution, vertical or ownership.
system: Save permitted values with record-version checking. Append before/after audit and retain original intake provenance.
report: A correction does not create a new lead or improve contact counts. Contact permission remains a separate record.
exception: Possible duplicate: pause the identity change and submit a review. Never merge customer records automatically from this form.

title: Create a permitted self-sourced enquiry
steps: Select New enquiry if the role grant enables manual creation.
Capture source, need and contact-permission evidence.
Submit enquiry to validation; receive its processing reference.
validation: Role permission, mandatory fields and source evidence are required. Run duplicate checks before making a new opportunity.
system: Store manual intake separately with origin and creator. Publish through normal routing; self-ownership is not assumed.
report: Source credit and sales ownership are separate. Invalid or duplicate intake is reported explicitly, not as fresh sales work.
exception: Existing enquiry: link or send for duplicate review. Missing permission keeps the record out of outbound contact queues.

title: Place a voice call
steps: Select Call after reviewing prospect context and channel eligibility.
During the call use Mute, Unmute and End call; each shows current call state.
After the call open mandatory wrap-up; record the actual result.
validation: Check assigned owner, contact permission, working hours, frequency cap and provider health before placing the call.
system: Request one provider call with an idempotency key. Show connecting, ringing, connected, ended or failed states.
report: Only unique provider-confirmed calls count as verified attempts. Connected duration comes from provider evidence.
exception: Provider unavailable: offer Retry or a labelled manual activity. Repeated button clicks must not start duplicate calls.

title: Complete call wrap-up and next action
steps: Choose Connected, No answer, Busy, Wrong number or Callback.
Record the conversation result and required next step.
Save wrap-up; move to the next eligible lead only after the save succeeds.
validation: Connected alone does not prove qualified need. Follow-up needs a due time and owner. No-answer cannot set Contacted.
system: Append activity and allowed stage event. Create/update the next task atomically and close the completed task.
report: Call facts use call-start date. Stage and task completion use their own event times; a repeated save counts once.
exception: Uncertain outcome: keep the call in Needs wrap-up. Unsaved notes stay in a recoverable draft with an expiry policy.

title: Record a manual call with clear evidence status
steps: Open Add activity and choose Manual call.
Enter actual event time, reason, outcome and next action.
Save as a manual entry; submit any required supervisor verification.
validation: Allow only a configured backdating window. Do not accept a future call time or fabricate a provider call ID.
system: Store actor, entered time, event time and manual verification status. Link follow-up and preserve edit history.
report: Show manual activity separately from verified call volume. Supervisor approval does not turn it into a provider event.
exception: Duplicate suspected: flag for TL review. Incorrect saved entries use a correction, not silent deletion.

title: Send an approved WhatsApp message
steps: Open WhatsApp from the prospect and choose an eligible template or allowed reply.
Review merged variables and recipient before Send.
Read queued, delivered, read, replied or failed status in the same conversation.
validation: Check current provider policy, eligible product, permission, conversation window, template approval and opt-out before sending.
system: Create one outbound message, store provider ID and reconcile signed delivery callbacks. Suppress queued outreach on opt-out.
report: Sent or delivered is not successful contact. A meaningful customer response can support contact with an activity record.
exception: Template unavailable or permission missing: disable Send with a reason. Use a secure document link for sensitive information.

title: Handle an inbound reply or missed call
steps: Open an unread conversation assigned to your workload.
Read prior context, answer within permitted channel rules and update the task.
Mark handled only after recording the response or next action.
validation: Resolve ambiguous enquiry matches without exposing other vertical conversations. Unowned replies route to a supervisor queue.
system: Deduplicate inbound event IDs. Append message to the right enquiry and notify its current owner or accountable queue.
report: Track first response and unresolved inbound age separately from outbound attempt counts.
exception: Ownership changed: route to the new owner. Never leave an inbound message assigned to a disabled account.

title: Schedule a follow-up
steps: Select Schedule follow-up from the lead or call wrap-up.
Pick date, time, action, purpose and reminder.
Save; the task appears in My calendar and the lead timeline.
validation: Require future due time, current owner and an eligible channel. Warn about conflicts and outside-hours appointments.
system: Create a versioned task and reminder job. Mark Follow-up stage if the transition is allowed.
report: The task enters the due-period denominator. Committed deadline and any later revision remain traceable.
exception: Duplicate open task for the same purpose: offer Update existing or explicitly confirm a separate task.

title: Reschedule a promised callback
steps: Open the due task and select Reschedule.
Enter the new time and a specific reason.
Save and send an eligible confirmation if selected.
validation: Keep the original deadline. Repeated deferrals or overdue moves may require TL approval under the configured threshold.
system: Append schedule revision, cancel obsolete reminder jobs and create replacements. Retain original SLA history.
report: Rescheduling never erases a missed commitment. Show revised workload and original on-time performance separately.
exception: Approval required: keep the old committed deadline active until the change is approved; display both dates clearly.

title: Complete, cancel or reopen a task
steps: Open the task and choose Complete, Request cancellation or Reopen correction.
Record the result and next action for an open opportunity.
Save; return to the calendar with the updated task state.
validation: Completion must have a truthful outcome. Cancellation needs an allowed reason; reopen after finalisation is a logged correction.
system: Write task transition and linked activity once. Cancel reminders for terminal tasks and create the next task where needed.
report: Eligible due tasks remain in the follow-up metric. Approved cancellations are excluded and reported separately.
exception: A task moved to another owner cannot be completed from a stale caller screen.

title: Book a prospect meeting or visit
steps: Select Book meeting and inspect available authorised slots.
Confirm attendees, location and agenda.
Book the slot and issue eligible invitations; record attended, no-show or cancelled later.
validation: Check slot conflicts, attendee access and product-specific requirements. External communication needs an approved channel.
system: Reserve the slot atomically, create attendee tasks and queue invitation delivery with separate delivery status.
report: Track booked, attended and no-show counts separately. Booking alone is not conversion.
exception: Slot taken during save: show alternative slots. Failed invitation does not silently cancel an already reserved appointment.

title: Qualify the opportunity
steps: Open Qualification from the prospect record.
Complete the product-specific checklist and record customer needs.
Save qualification; use the recommended next action inside the permitted pipeline.
validation: Mandatory qualification fields depend on the configured product. An estimate cannot be entered as verified revenue.
system: Persist answers with checklist version and append activity. Suggest the next milestone without auto-approving a sale.
report: Show qualification completion and estimated pipeline separately from verified outcomes.
exception: Product mismatch: request an approved referral. The caller cannot change the lead into another vertical.

title: Move an opportunity in the pipeline
steps: Drag a card or choose Change stage for an owned opportunity.
Complete the transition form shown for the target stage.
Confirm; return the card to its original stage if the server rejects the change.
validation: Server validates the allowed state transition, ownership and required fields. Converted always follows approval rules.
system: Append a stage event with prior state, actor, reason and rule version. Update related tasks in the same transaction.
report: Stage counts and ageing refresh from authoritative events. Dragging a card without saving changes no metrics.
exception: Stale record: show the newer stage and request review. A UI drag cannot bypass a locked or rejected milestone.

title: Prepare and send a proposal
steps: Select Prepare proposal and populate approved product information.
Preview terms and any exception requiring superior approval.
Submit for approval or Send approved proposal through an eligible channel.
validation: No unapproved return claims, altered mandatory terms or discounts outside authority. Required disclosures come from approved content.
system: Version the proposal, store approval evidence and log send status. Preserve earlier versions as read-only.
report: Proposal sent is a pipeline milestone, not won revenue. Report pending commercial approvals separately.
exception: Expired or withdrawn product content blocks sending. An approved proposal edited afterward must be approved again.

title: Request documents securely
steps: Open Documents and select the approved checklist.
Generate a secure upload request and preview the customer message.
Send via an eligible channel and monitor pending items.
validation: Only request permitted documents for this product and stage. Do not request full sensitive identifiers inside chat.
system: Issue scoped upload tokens, store expiry and link evidence to the opportunity. Scan uploaded files before release.
report: Document completeness is operational progress. An uploaded file is not automatically verified.
exception: Expired link can be replaced after permission checking. A suspicious file stays quarantined and unavailable to users.

title: Upload, replace or inspect evidence
steps: Open an allowed document slot or upload on behalf of the customer when permitted.
Inspect scan status and request review; replace via a new version if needed.
Download only when the role and document policy permit it.
validation: Check file type, size, malware status and field-level access. Caller cannot self-mark independent evidence as verified.
system: Use private storage and short-lived links. Keep version and access audit; enforce the approved retention policy.
report: Report requested, received, accepted and rejected evidence separately.
exception: Rejected evidence shows the reviewer reason and correction path. No hard deletion of evidence supporting an approved sale.

title: Submit a conversion for approval
steps: Open Submit conversion when required product milestones are complete.
Review amount, evidence and credit allocation.
Submit; the record enters Pending conversion and routes to the eligible superior.
validation: Require complete evidence, no unresolved blocking exceptions and an independent approver. Credit splits must total 100%.
system: Create a versioned approval request. Lock the submitted payload and notify the correct TL or next independent approver.
report: Pending submissions do not count as wins. Approved conversion uses its effective event date and locked attribution.
exception: Rejected submission returns with precise reasons. The caller corrects and resubmits a new version without losing history.

title: Mark a lead lost with a useful reason
steps: Select Mark lost from the lead record.
Choose a structured reason and add relevant context.
Confirm loss; an opt-out request must also update contact suppression immediately.
validation: Loss requires an allowed reason. Duplicate and invalid-data cases use their own dispositions rather than inflating sales losses.
system: Append loss event and cancel obsolete sales tasks. Preserve conversation and ownership history.
report: Loss analysis groups by product, reason, source and event-time hierarchy. Cohort metrics preserve their defined denominator.
exception: Converted records cannot be changed to Lost by the caller. Use a cancellation/refund request to protect financial history.

title: Request a lost opportunity to be reopened
steps: Open permitted lost history and select Request reopen.
Explain the new customer signal and next action.
Submit to TL; work resumes only after approval and current ownership confirmation.
validation: Contact suppression remains binding. A new product or independent enquiry may need a linked new opportunity instead.
system: Create reopen approval and preserve the original loss event. On approval, append a reopen event and create a task.
report: Report reopen counts separately. Reopening does not create another first-assigned lead in the same cohort.
exception: Old lead outside current scope: send a reference-only request through support; do not reveal its customer details.

title: Request a handoff or cross-vertical referral
steps: Select Request handoff or Refer enquiry.
Provide reason, approved destination and customer permission.
Submit; keep working only on the current authorised responsibility until acceptance.
validation: Caller cannot browse destination staff or vertical data. Cross-vertical referral creates a scoped linked enquiry, not shared ownership.
system: Notify receiving authority, record accept/decline and handoff deadline. Move tasks only for an approved same-enquiry transfer.
report: Earlier activities stay with the original actor. Referral credit, if used, is separately configured and cannot duplicate revenue.
exception: Declined referral returns with reason. The sender sees handoff status, not the receiving vertical workspace.

title: Record an opt-out or contact complaint
steps: Select Contact preferences or Record complaint immediately.
Capture the exact request and affected channels.
Save suppression and raise a complaint task if resolution is needed.
validation: An explicit opt-out takes effect immediately and needs no sales approval. Broader contact restrictions override campaign settings.
system: Update suppression, cancel queued outbound messages and notify the current owner. Link complaint to an accountable resolution queue.
report: Suppressed contacts are visible as a separate operational category. Users cannot erase opt-out to improve reachability.
exception: Conflicting channel evidence is reviewed by the policy owner; outreach remains blocked for the disputed channel.

title: Inspect personal performance and its calculation
steps: Open Performance and choose period and metric.
Select a KPI to inspect its formula, numerator, denominator and eligible evidence.
Switch to permitted career history for prior roles without opening a previous role interface.
validation: Personal facts stay tied to the employee. Current-team and event-time performance are clearly separated; zero targets show N/A.
system: Query versioned metric facts using period timezone and cutoff. Mask historical customer details outside current scope.
report: Show verified/manual activity, transfers received, targets, wins, credited revenue and last refresh independently.
exception: Late evidence displays a revised report version. Open finance periods remain provisional and visibly labelled.

title: Prepare for and acknowledge a one-to-one
steps: Open an assigned review and complete self-reflection.
During the meeting review the frozen scorecard and agree action items.
Acknowledge receipt and add a response; track each commitment until completed.
validation: Acknowledgement is not agreement. Employee cannot alter the reviewer rating or see private restricted reviewer notes.
system: Version review content, store acknowledgement time and create follow-up tasks. Record changes after the meeting.
report: Review completion and commitment closure appear in the permitted coaching report, separate from sales results.
exception: Disputed metric: submit a correction request linked to the evidence. Do not overwrite the meeting snapshot silently.

title: Generate a personal meeting PDF
steps: Choose Export PDF and review the included sections.
Generate the pack and wait for Ready, or inspect failure details.
Download from the authenticated report centre; sharing follows the approved recipient rules.
validation: Caller can export only permitted personal data. Recheck scope at generation and download; minimise prospect identifiers.
system: Create export job with snapshot, recipient, expiry and audit. Watermark the file and revoke pending jobs after access changes.
report: PDF stores metric version, cutoff and period. It must reconcile with the selected on-screen snapshot.
exception: Access revoked before download: deny the file. Downloaded copies cannot be technically recalled.

title: Raise a blocker or request a metric correction
steps: Open Help or Raise issue on the affected record.
Describe the blocker and attach permitted evidence.
Submit, track response and confirm resolution without editing protected facts directly.
validation: Request must reference a record the caller may identify. Attachment and text rules prevent unauthorised cross-team disclosure.
system: Route to TL, operations, finance or access support by category. Record owner, SLA, decisions and correction linkage.
report: Accepted corrections append an adjustment or revised fact and retain the prior report version.
exception: Urgent access issue goes to Super Admin. A pending dispute never grants temporary access to another dashboard.

title: Inspect team health and drill into a metric
steps: Select an authorised team or the deduplicated union.
Click a KPI to open its member and opportunity breakdown.
Assign a corrective task inside the TL interface.
validation: Team filters come from current grants. Historic performance uses the approved historical path; overlapping grants count each fact once.
system: Load team summaries and scoped detail. Retain filter context when returning from an employee or opportunity view.
report: Display actual/target, overdue work, idle capacity, pending approvals and data freshness.
exception: Revoked team disappears immediately. Drill-down is a TL view of permitted records, never the caller dashboard.

title: Allocate an unassigned lead
steps: Select a lead from an authorised unassigned queue.
Inspect eligible associates, workload and skill match.
Assign and review the ownership and task handoff receipt.
validation: Lead and recipient must both fit scope. Check active employment, leave, product eligibility and capacity.
system: Atomically create ownership, first-contact task and assignment notification using the record version.
report: First allocation counts as a new assignment. Transfer and reassignment counts remain separate.
exception: No eligible associate: retain visible queue ownership and escalate capacity need. Never assign to a disabled user.

title: Distribute a batch using a preview
steps: Select a bounded batch and choose automatic distribution.
Review the proposed recipient for every lead and exclusions.
Confirm the preview; inspect success, conflict and held results.
validation: Revalidate scope and capacity at commit. Overlapping selections or concurrent allocators cannot double-assign a lead.
system: Use a unique batch key and atomic assignment per lead. Return a per-record result and retry only failures.
report: Measure queue age and fair distribution separately from employee conversion.
exception: A stale or newly ineligible recipient fails that row. Partial completion must be visible and downloadable within scope.

title: Rebalance work within granted teams
steps: Select eligible open work and inspect owner/task impact.
Choose an authorised recipient and handoff deadline.
Confirm reassignment and notify both employees.
validation: Preserve original due times and activity attribution. Moving between teams requires explicit authority over both.
system: Close old ownership interval, create new interval and move open tasks together. Record the handoff note.
report: Inherited backlog appears separately for the recipient. Earlier calls and wins never become their personal work.
exception: Locked pending approvals need explicit handling. Cross-boundary moves become a Manager request instead.

title: Resolve an overdue follow-up
steps: Open the overdue queue sorted by severity.
Review original promise, attempts and blocker.
Assign a recovery action or permitted handoff and monitor completion.
validation: TL cannot erase missed deadlines or backdate completion. New contact must remain channel-eligible.
system: Append escalation and recovery task with owner, deadline and reason. Keep the original task history.
report: Track breach count, overdue age and time to recovery alongside sales outcomes.
exception: Repeated breach crosses the configured threshold: notify Manager with the evidence pack.

title: Review an associate within the TL workspace
steps: Open a member from the TL team roster.
Inspect workload, eligible metrics, training and coaching commitments.
Open an authorised lead or start a review without switching role.
validation: Only granted members and allowed historical summaries are visible. Sensitive HR fields and other vertical work remain excluded.
system: Combine current workload with clearly labelled historical fact segments. Audit sensitive evidence access.
report: Separate personal activity, inherited work and team-attributed outcomes.
exception: Employee transfers away: current details close. Historical access follows the explicit report retention grant.

title: Approve or return a conversion
steps: Open the pending conversion and check product evidence.
Approve within authority or Return with specific missing items.
Review the decision receipt and finance handoff state.
validation: Approver must differ from submitter. Check current scope, limits, rule version and unchanged payload.
system: Append decision. Approval locks conversion attribution and creates the appropriate finance verification task.
report: Win count changes only once on approval. Revenue remains separate until the finance rule is satisfied.
exception: Conflict, missing evidence or absent authority blocks approval and routes to the next eligible approver.

title: Resolve a reopen or duplicate request
steps: Review original outcome, new evidence and current contact restrictions.
Approve a permitted reopen or route an identity merge to the data steward.
Record reason and notify the requester.
validation: Merge authority is a separate permission. Never collapse distinct products or cross-vertical opportunities by matching phone alone.
system: Append reopen decision or reviewed duplicate disposition. Retain original IDs and source links.
report: Duplicate exclusions and reopen counts stay auditable in cohort reports.
exception: Restricted cross-vertical match shows only a match-review reference, not the other vertical customer record.

title: Review call quality and log coaching
steps: Open a permitted activity and authorised evidence.
Score the approved rubric and cite factual observations.
Save feedback and create a private coaching task for the associate.
validation: Recording access requires an explicit grant and approved policy. A quality score cannot replace sales metrics.
system: Store rubric version, evidence reference, reviewer and feedback visibility. Log playback/download access.
report: Report sample size and assessed calls so small samples do not imply full employee coverage.
exception: Missing or unavailable recording: mark unassessed. Never invent a score from call duration alone.

title: Distribute an approved team target
steps: Open the approved team target and draft employee allocations.
Inspect total allocation, start dates and any approved prorating.
Submit or publish within delegated target authority.
validation: Child allocations must reconcile to the parent with an explicit remainder. No silent changes to closed periods.
system: Version target allocation and notify affected employees. Route exceptions to Manager.
report: Attainment uses the applicable approved target version and actual metric for the same period.
exception: Transfer mid-period: apply the approved prorating rule, preserve prior target versions and explain the difference.

title: Submit the team forecast
steps: Review eligible opportunities and expected closing dates.
Challenge unsupported amounts or stage assumptions.
Submit a dated team forecast to Manager with risks and actions.
validation: Separate won value from expected CRM revenue. Stage probability comes from the approved version, not arbitrary optimism.
system: Freeze forecast version, supporting opportunity IDs and assumptions. Notify Manager of submission or revision.
report: Later compare submitted forecast with actual outcomes using the same period, currency and revenue basis.
exception: Unpriced or stale opportunities appear as incomplete. Exclude them from numeric totals until their basis is defined.

title: Schedule and run an associate one-to-one
steps: Schedule the meeting and request employee reflection.
Review evidence, record feedback and agree actions.
Complete the review and request acknowledgement.
validation: Use authorised period data and separate private reviewer notes. Employee disagreement remains recorded.
system: Freeze the meeting snapshot, create commitments and version later edits.
report: Track review completion, acknowledgement and overdue commitments separately.
exception: Missing employee response does not imply agreement. An unresolved data dispute stays linked to the review.

title: Assign an intern mentor and graded workload
steps: Inspect active intern permissions and completed training.
Assign permitted work and mentor-review requirements.
Review quality before requesting wider access.
validation: TL can allocate work but cannot grant a new role. Mentor visibility is scoped, dated and explicitly authorised.
system: Create mentorship and task assignments. Submit permission expansion to HR/Super Admin when justified.
report: Separate trainee output, mentor reviews and independent conversions.
exception: Expired internship or mentor delegation blocks further allocation and alerts the accountable supervisor.

title: Request a move, role change or capacity increase
steps: Create a staffing or access request with supporting workload evidence.
Propose timing and work handoff; send to Manager/HR.
Track approval and the Super Admin activation outcome.
validation: Requesting a change grants no new access. Organisational changes require business approval and admin execution.
system: Record lifecycle request, approval chain and unresolved handoff items.
report: Capacity request reporting includes queue impact and response time, not a fabricated staffing change.
exception: Rejected request leaves current assignments unchanged and displays the decision reason.

title: Escalate a complaint or commercial exception
steps: Review the issue and immediate contact restrictions.
Select severity, requested decision and proposed owner.
Submit to Manager or the designated policy/finance queue.
validation: Apply configured escalation routing. TL cannot approve finance adjustments or conceal a contact restriction.
system: Create an exception with due time, escalation path and immutable evidence references.
report: Report open exceptions, ageing and resolution; do not remove the related lead from performance without an approved rule.
exception: Urgent suppression takes effect before the approval workflow. Owner absence activates the named delegation.

title: Generate a team review pack
steps: Select authorised teams and report period.
Preview team totals and individual appendix, including exclusions.
Generate the PDF and open its audited download entry.
validation: Union scopes deduplicate facts. Every appendix uses the same cutoff and formula version as its summary.
system: Create a snapshot-bound export and validate recipient and current scope when generated and downloaded.
report: Include six report periods, original/revised versions and a target reconciliation summary.
exception: A removed team is excluded from pending exports. Exports never include another role interface or unauthorised member records.

title: Schedule a recurring report
steps: Choose a saved team report and cadence.
Select eligible recipients and preview report scope.
Save schedule; inspect last run, next run and failure state.
validation: Recipient and owner permissions are rechecked every run. Report schedules never preserve revoked scope.
system: Create a scheduled job with deduplication key. Produce one version per period and alert on failure.
report: Report provenance includes schedule owner, as-of date, metric version and distribution audit.
exception: Owner offboarded or grant expired: suspend schedule pending an authorised replacement. No automatic public email attachment.

title: Approve a documented activity correction
steps: Compare original activity, provider evidence and employee explanation.
Approve an append-only correction within authority or return with reason.
Notify the employee and flag affected report versions.
validation: Provider truth cannot be overridden without supporting evidence. Closed finance facts use finance adjustments instead.
system: Append correction with reviewer and original fact reference; trigger permitted metric recomputation.
report: Historical snapshots retain their original version and show the approved revised version.
exception: Self-submitted correction goes to Manager. Never delete an unfavourable activity to improve a scorecard.

title: Investigate performance across team leaders
steps: Inspect target pace, ageing and backlog by TL.
Open a TL contribution and drill into permitted evidence.
Assign an intervention owner inside the Manager workspace.
validation: No access to sibling Managers or other verticals. Team percentages must be recomputed from eligible totals.
system: Load descendant facts and current workload separately; preserve drill-down filters.
report: Show numerator, denominator, cutoffs and data gaps for fair comparisons.
exception: A low sample-size team displays its sample size; do not automatically rank it as best or worst.

title: Inspect a TL operating scorecard
steps: Open the TL record from the authorised roster.
Review allocation, approvals, forecasts and coaching commitments.
Create a management action with an accountable owner.
validation: View only permitted employee and sales fields. The TL personal interface is never opened or impersonated.
system: Join authorised TL assignments with team facts and review records.
report: Keep team performance separate from any independently granted personal selling activity.
exception: Historical teams moved outside scope expose only approved historical summaries.

title: Approve a cross-team lead transfer
steps: Inspect source and destination eligibility plus task impact.
Approve exact records or return for correction.
Review transfer completion and unresolved rows.
validation: Both teams must be within the Manager scope. Do not change role assignments as part of a lead transfer.
system: Apply ownership/task changes atomically per record and notify both TLs.
report: Preserve old activity attribution and flag transferred backlog for the new owners.
exception: Out-of-scope destination routes to RM. A conflict at commit returns a record-specific failure.

title: Build a capacity recovery plan
steps: Compare due work with eligible available capacity.
Model permitted reallocation and required additional staff.
Approve the operational plan and assign deadlines.
validation: Capacity uses approved availability, training and workload caps, not raw headcount.
system: Record plan version and tasks. Only confirmed assignments change live ownership.
report: Measure queue age, utilisation and recovery milestones without resetting SLA clocks.
exception: Hiring/role changes become HR/Admin requests. A scenario is clearly labelled until enacted.

title: Allocate Manager targets to TLs
steps: Open the approved Manager target.
Allocate by TL and review total reconciliation.
Publish within authority or submit a target exception to RM.
validation: Use the same metric, currency and period as the parent. Changes to locked targets require a new approved version.
system: Store parent-child allocations and notify affected TLs.
report: Attainment and historical comparisons refer to the applicable version.
exception: Unallocated remainder is visible and never silently distributed.

title: Challenge and approve TL forecasts
steps: Inspect changes since the prior submission.
Open supporting opportunities and challenge unsupported claims.
Accept a version or return specific corrections.
validation: Forecast must use the approved expected-revenue basis. Returned forecasts stay separate from accepted totals.
system: Append review decision and consolidate accepted versions only.
report: Measure forecast accuracy against the same period and basis after outcomes mature.
exception: Late submissions remain flagged; no silent substitution with zero or the previous month.

title: Submit the Manager forecast to RM
steps: Review accepted team submissions and remaining gaps.
Add an explicit management adjustment with evidence if allowed.
Submit the versioned Manager forecast to RM.
validation: Show bottom-up total and management adjustment separately. Prevent duplicate opportunities across teams.
system: Freeze submission, evidence set and assumptions; notify RM.
report: Track forecast changes and eventual accuracy with the original version retained.
exception: An unapproved override cannot enter the official forecast.

title: Resolve a repeated SLA failure
steps: Review breach history and the TL recovery attempt.
Assign corrective actions, capacity changes or coaching.
Close only after evidence confirms recovery.
validation: Closing the escalation does not erase the underlying breach. Contact suppression still applies.
system: Store decision, accountable TL, due dates and escalation to RM if unresolved.
report: Show repeat rate, recovery time and overdue action counts.
exception: If the cause is source quality or an outage, label it and route to the accountable service owner.

title: Approve a delegated commercial exception
steps: Compare requested terms with approved product terms.
Approve within an explicit limit or escalate to authorised owner.
Return a versioned decision to the proposal workflow.
validation: Unset limits mean no approval authority. Product eligibility and mandatory terms remain enforced.
system: Write approval to the exact proposal version and invalidate it if material terms change.
report: Track exception volume and downstream verified commercial effect.
exception: Finance or policy exceptions go to the relevant owner; Manager title does not authorise them automatically.

title: Review source quality and request remediation
steps: Compare sources using consistent cohorts and observation windows.
Inspect authorised examples and data-quality reasons.
Create a source correction or routing-change request.
validation: Sample sizes and source costs must be visible. Do not infer ROI without approved cost data.
system: Link source-quality issue to intake batches and campaign provenance.
report: Separate invalid intake, failed contact and commercial losses.
exception: Changes to source routing follow configuration approval; reports alone do not change allocation rules.

title: Run a TL performance review
steps: Prepare the snapshot and invite the TL reflection.
Record strengths, blockers, commitments and support needed.
Complete the review and monitor acknowledgement and actions.
validation: Use only scoped evidence. Record disagreement and avoid replacing the historical report with current hierarchy totals.
system: Version review and distribute visible commitments to authorised participants.
report: Track review cadence and action completion alongside operating results.
exception: An unresolved metric dispute remains open and linked to the signed meeting version.

title: Request employee transfers or promotions
steps: Review role readiness and scope impact.
Submit the lifecycle request to HR and the required business approver.
Track Super Admin activation without editing the account yourself.
validation: Request must preserve permanent identity and specify effective time, new reporting path and workload treatment.
system: Create a lifecycle workflow and block activation until required approvals/handoff checks are complete.
report: Past performance remains attached to the old assignment. Future facts use the new assignment.
exception: A rejected promotion does not modify permissions or expose the TL interface.

title: Publish the Manager meeting pack
steps: Select period, scope and approved snapshot.
Preview summary reconciliation and TL appendix.
Generate and distribute through the protected report centre.
validation: Six period options share the same metric definitions. Appendices cannot widen scope.
system: Create audited PDF export and optional permission-checked recurring schedule.
report: Include forecast version, target version, cutoff, exclusions and open action owners.
exception: Missing provider data is flagged in the pack rather than portrayed as employee underperformance.

title: Investigate regional gaps
steps: Inspect Manager contributions and regional exceptions.
Select a metric to drill through Managers, TLs and permitted evidence.
Create an intervention while staying in the RM workspace.
validation: Geographic scope never grants other vertical data. Scope is vertical plus assigned organisation.
system: Query unique descendant facts and render separate current-capacity measures.
report: Show regional attainment, source mix, backlog, forecast and action progress.
exception: Historical restructuring is shown by dated segments, not rewritten to match the current organisation.

title: Review a Manager scorecard
steps: Open an authorised Manager.
Inspect contribution, forecast accuracy and unresolved actions.
Assign a management action or schedule a review.
validation: Only permitted fields and descendants are available; there is no Manager-dashboard impersonation.
system: Combine current operating records and historical facts with clear labels.
report: Separate operational health and actual sales performance.
exception: Transferred Managers expose only approved history for the period of the RM relationship.

title: Plan territory coverage
steps: Inspect lead demand against current authorised coverage.
Propose queue-to-team coverage changes.
Submit the dated configuration change for approved activation.
validation: Coverage changes cannot directly grant employees another vertical. Validate eligible skills and geography.
system: Version routing proposal, approver and activation date; Admin publishes approved configuration.
report: Compare response time and conversion before/after with stable cohort definitions.
exception: No eligible destination keeps the queue visible and assigned to an accountable supervisor.

title: Allocate regional targets to Managers
steps: Open the regional target approved by NM.
Allocate by Manager and validate totals.
Publish authorised allocation or request a change from NM.
validation: Metric and financial basis must match parent targets. Historic locked allocations are versioned.
system: Persist allocation version and notify Managers.
report: Track allocated, unallocated and achieved values separately.
exception: A mid-period restructure requires approved prorating and preserves earlier assignments.

title: Approve a cross-Manager transfer
steps: Inspect eligibility, tasks and forecast impact on both sides.
Approve specific transfers within the assigned region and vertical.
Review successful changes and any conflicts.
validation: Both organisational branches must be granted. Original event attribution and deadlines remain unchanged.
system: Execute version-checked ownership/task transactions and notify affected Managers.
report: Report transferred work separately from new allocations and preserve old activity credit.
exception: Other-region destination requires NM approval; another vertical requires the referral workflow.

title: Approve a regional staffing plan
steps: Review Manager capacity proposals and expected demand.
Prioritise staffing requests within the approved regional envelope.
Submit required hiring/role approvals to HR and authorised leadership.
validation: Plan approval is not a permission grant or hire completion. Role changes still require Super Admin execution.
system: Version staffing recommendation and create accountable implementation tasks.
report: Show planned, approved and active capacity separately.
exception: Budget beyond authority escalates; the system must not treat requested headcount as available capacity.

title: Submit the regional forecast
steps: Review accepted Manager forecasts and open gaps.
Add supported regional assumptions separately.
Submit a frozen forecast and risk register to NM.
validation: Deduplicate opportunities and use a common expected-revenue basis. Preserve every submitted version.
system: Store forecast provenance, changes and submission time.
report: Compare prediction and actual on matched periods after data maturity.
exception: Incomplete submissions are disclosed and escalated; no silent roll-forward.

title: Resolve a regional escalation
steps: Assess evidence and affected teams.
Assign a recovery decision, owner and deadline.
Escalate to NM if policy, budget or geography exceeds authority.
validation: Use explicit delegation and limits. Finance decisions stay within finance authority.
system: Append decision and follow-up tasks; retain unresolved risk history.
report: Track regional risk ageing and recovery evidence.
exception: Overdue high-severity risks notify NM automatically under the configured escalation policy.

title: Run a Manager review
steps: Prepare evidence and Manager self-reflection.
Record decisions, support and improvement commitments.
Complete, acknowledge and follow up before the next review.
validation: Historical contribution is scoped to the relationship period; private notes have separate visibility.
system: Store meeting snapshot, response and action ownership.
report: Review cadence and completion are distinct from sales attainment.
exception: Metric disputes remain attached to the review and use the correction workflow.

title: Produce the regional review pack
steps: Choose period and permitted report sections.
Preview summary-to-Manager reconciliation.
Generate the protected PDF and optional approved schedule.
validation: Region label does not widen vertical permissions. Revalidate both recipient and export owner.
system: Generate snapshot-bound report with versions and audit trail.
report: Include target bridge, forecast changes, quality flags and open actions.
exception: Changes to scope suspend affected schedules until a permitted owner confirms them.

title: Inspect national vertical performance
steps: Inspect region contributions, national pipeline and unresolved risk.
Drill into authorised regional evidence within the NM interface.
Assign an accountable regional action.
validation: Other vertical data is excluded unless separately granted for the same role. Union views never double-count facts.
system: Aggregate immutable event-time facts and show current workload separately.
report: National metrics show formula, cutoff, currency and source readiness.
exception: Missing regional data displays as incomplete; it never appears as a zero-performance region.

title: Compare regions and open an RM scorecard
steps: Compare eligible regional scorecards.
Inspect sample size, source mix and target basis before drawing conclusions.
Open an RM record and agree a regional improvement action.
validation: Comparison needs consistent currency, cohort and observation cutoff. No RM interface is opened.
system: Serve authorised breakdowns and maintain filter context.
report: Show actual results plus reasons for incomparable or immature cohorts.
exception: Changing filters does not change official submitted report versions.

title: Allocate the national target to regions
steps: Open the agreed vertical target and capacity assumptions.
Allocate regional targets using the same metric basis.
Publish delegated allocations or submit a change for approval.
validation: Annual, quarterly and monthly targets must reconcile by approved policy. Preserve effective versions.
system: Store parent-child target relationships and notify RMs.
report: Show allocation balance and later achievement against the applicable version.
exception: A CEO target revision triggers controlled downstream revision, not silent overwrite.

title: Review product and source economics
steps: Compare product/source cohorts and data completeness.
Inspect verified commercial outcomes and approved cost inputs.
Propose a source, product or budget action with evidence.
validation: ROI appears only with defined attributable revenue and validated costs. Revenue and gross sales values must not mix.
system: Link proposal to source facts, cost version and approval workflow.
report: Show sample size, time lag, cancellations and cost coverage alongside ratios.
exception: Unknown cost displays N/A for ROI and a data-owner action.

title: Propose pipeline or product rule changes
steps: Draft milestone, evidence, template or routing changes.
Preview affected opportunities and reporting definitions.
Submit to required product/finance owners and Admin for publication.
validation: Existing work retains its rule version unless an explicit migration is approved. Mandatory policy terms cannot be bypassed.
system: Store change proposal, approvers, test evidence and scheduled activation.
report: Reports label rule versions so before/after comparisons remain interpretable.
exception: Failed validation blocks publication. NM proposal does not directly rewrite all active opportunities.

title: Submit the national forecast
steps: Review regional submissions, ageing and stage assumptions.
Document the national adjustment and main risks.
Submit a frozen vertical forecast to authorised executive recipients.
validation: Use approved expected CRM revenue and comparable periods. Customer detail is only attached where explicitly permitted.
system: Version forecast and notify CEO sales review and CFO financial review workflows.
report: Retain bottom-up, adjustment and final values for later forecast-accuracy assessment.
exception: Unresolved regional submissions are visible in the national pack.

title: Approve a cross-region work transfer
steps: Review both regional approvals and recipient eligibility.
Approve exact records and effective handoff.
Confirm completion to both RMs.
validation: Both regions must be in the granted vertical. Keep past credit and original task deadlines.
system: Execute per-record ownership transactions with audit and notifications.
report: Transfer reports distinguish moved backlog from new business generation.
exception: Cross-vertical need uses a new linked enquiry with explicit receiving acceptance.

title: Accept or decline a cross-vertical referral
steps: Inspect the minimal referral payload and receiving-product fit.
Accept into an authorised queue or decline with reason.
Notify the sender of status without granting receiver-workspace access.
validation: Receiving authority must be explicitly granted. Check consent and duplicates inside receiving scope.
system: Create/link the receiving opportunity with provenance. Preserve separate ownership and source records.
report: A referral is a separate operational event; any incentive credit follows an approved non-duplicating rule.
exception: No acceptance leaves the request pending and escalates at its deadline; it does not expose the other vertical.

title: Escalate a national commercial or finance issue
steps: Document the issue and proposed action.
Route execution or strategy to CEO, finance policy to CFO, and access changes to Admin.
Track decisions and resulting action owners.
validation: Dual executive reporting does not duplicate hierarchy facts or grant financial approval authority to NM.
system: Create linked decision requests with independent owners where both subjects are involved.
report: Show decision ageing, dependencies and affected forecast version.
exception: Conflicting decisions pause the dependent action and escalate to the named accountable executive.

title: Run an RM performance review
steps: Prepare the regional snapshot and request reflection.
Review results, resourcing and follow-through.
Complete the meeting and track agreed commitments.
validation: Use approved historical attribution and permitted employee data. Acknowledgement does not imply agreement.
system: Store review version, employee response and dated actions.
report: Review effectiveness measures completed commitments alongside commercial results.
exception: Unresolved metric corrections remain visible and linked.

title: Prepare the national executive pack
steps: Select approved report versions and recipient-specific sections.
Preview reconciliation to regional totals.
Generate the protected executive pack and schedule if authorised.
validation: CFO receives relevant finance content; raw customer evidence requires a separate grant. No extra verticals are inferred.
system: Store export snapshot, audience, expiry and generation status.
report: Pack identifies target, forecast and finance close versions plus open decisions.
exception: A scope or recipient change invalidates queued exports and is evaluated again before delivery.

title: Inspect the company operating picture
steps: Inspect attainment, pipeline, forecast confidence and critical decisions.
Open a vertical contribution within the executive workspace.
Assign a named strategic action or leadership review.
validation: Company aggregation is an explicit scope grant. It does not grant another role interface or unrestricted customer/HR access.
system: Aggregate reconciled vertical facts with clear freshness and finance close status.
report: Separate approved won value, recognised revenue and cash throughout the executive view.
exception: Unreconciled or missing vertical data is visibly flagged and excluded from certified totals as appropriate.

title: Compare verticals fairly
steps: Choose comparable measures and observation periods.
Inspect target pace, growth and operating constraints by vertical.
Record decisions with the supporting comparison snapshot.
validation: Do not rank different products by raw lead count alone. Separate differing sales cycles, margins and data maturity.
system: Store selected context and attach it to executive decisions.
report: Show basis, denominators, currencies and FX versions on comparative financial measures.
exception: Incomparable or incomplete data shows a labelled limitation rather than an invented rank.

title: Review a national manager contribution
steps: Open the NM contribution from the company view.
Review results, risks, accepted forecasts and action delivery.
Schedule a leadership review or request clarification.
validation: Executive drill-down is a CEO view. Lower-level customer evidence remains separately permissioned.
system: Serve authorised national summaries and action references.
report: Historical responsibility follows the NM assignment at event time.
exception: An NM replacement sees a new personal record; the vertical retains organisational history.

title: Approve company and vertical targets
steps: Review bottom-up capacity and the proposed company plan.
Approve targets and reconcile vertical allocations.
Publish the signed target version for NM cascade.
validation: Define metric, currency, period and owner. Company total equals allocations plus a visible reserved/unallocated amount.
system: Lock approved version, effective dates and audit. Notify NMs and relevant finance owners.
report: Future attainment uses the signed target version. Mid-cycle changes require a visible revision.
exception: Unresolved finance basis or inconsistent allocations block final approval.

title: Review the consolidated company forecast
steps: Inspect national submissions and consolidation gaps.
Review executive adjustments separately from bottom-up totals.
Freeze the executive forecast for the leadership meeting.
validation: Deduplicate linked revenue and avoid counting referrals twice. Use consistent expected-revenue definitions.
system: Store final forecast, source versions and adjustment rationale.
report: Track original forecast accuracy, revisions and realised outcomes by period.
exception: Unaccepted or late submissions remain visible rather than silently replaced.

title: Approve a growth or capacity initiative
steps: Review expected outcome, capacity assumptions and dependencies.
Approve strategic direction within authority and request finance concurrence where needed.
Assign milestones and review dates.
validation: Strategic approval is separate from finance funding approval and employee access provisioning.
system: Create linked executive decision, finance decision and implementation tasks.
report: Track approved plan against actual milestones and measured outcome, not only planned benefits.
exception: Budget not approved: keep initiative conditionally approved and block dependent spending commitments.

title: Resolve a cross-vertical priority conflict
steps: Review both NM proposals and customer/service impact.
Record the priority, limits and follow-up commitments.
Notify affected NMs and route access changes through Admin if needed.
validation: A commercial priority does not automatically share customer data or employee permissions across verticals.
system: Version decision and create scoped work requests rather than broad shared access.
report: Track implementation and exception resolution against the original decision.
exception: If policy or finance approval is required, keep the action pending until that independent decision is complete.

title: Review a critical complaint or operating risk
steps: Inspect the executive risk summary and previous decisions.
Set accountable owner, priority and due date.
Escalate specialist decisions to finance or policy owners where appropriate.
validation: Show only the minimum required personal/customer information. Preserve evidence and suppression controls.
system: Log executive decision and escalation chain; notify affected owners.
report: Risk dashboard tracks overdue decisions and verified resolution, not only ticket closure.
exception: A sensitive incident may require a restricted case grant; seniority alone cannot bypass that boundary.

title: Conduct an NM leadership review
steps: Prepare a frozen vertical scorecard and prior commitments.
Record leadership feedback, support and measurable actions.
Complete the review and request acknowledgement.
validation: Use historical assignment attribution. Keep confidential reviewer notes separate from shared actions.
system: Version review and route commitments to named owners.
report: Track commitments and leadership review cadence independently of revenue measures.
exception: A disputed finance number remains linked to the CFO-certified version and correction process.

title: Create the executive or board meeting pack
steps: Choose certified snapshots and recipient-appropriate detail.
Preview the executive narrative, charts and decision list.
Generate an audited PDF with protected download and expiry.
validation: Board access is not assumed as a user role. External recipients require an explicitly approved sharing process.
system: Store report version, audience, redactions and download audit.
report: Every chart carries its metric basis, cutoff and finance state.
exception: If a section is provisional, label it clearly instead of mixing it into certified results.

title: Follow through on executive commitments
steps: Review decisions requiring action and overdue commitments.
Update own actions or request evidence from the accountable leader.
Close only after recording the actual outcome.
validation: Delegating an action does not delegate a role, approval limit or dashboard access.
system: Append action changes, evidence and notifications with due-time history.
report: Measure commitment completion and decision latency separately from sales attainment.
exception: Overdue delegated actions return to the accountable sponsor for intervention.

title: Inspect revenue, cash and outstanding balances
steps: Review recognised revenue, receipts, receivables and unmatched cash.
Click a balance to open the contributing ledger entries.
Open a reconciliation or approval task inside the CFO interface.
validation: Separate sales value, revenue, cash and balances. Never sum mixed currencies without approved FX conversion.
system: Query finance ledger and sales reconciliation views with source watermark and close version.
report: Display reconciliation gaps and provisional totals alongside approved figures.
exception: Finance-feed outage freezes the last valid balance with a stale label; it does not report zero cash.

title: Verify a sales-to-finance handoff
steps: Open the finance handoff from an approved conversion.
Check earning milestone, amount, beneficiary and supporting evidence.
Accept for finance processing or return precise missing information.
validation: Sales conversion alone is insufficient. Independent approval and approved revenue policy are required.
system: Record finance verification and create the next recognition/invoice task without duplicating the sales win.
report: Track pending finance handoffs and processing age separately from conversion counts.
exception: Conflicting amount or missing evidence blocks finance posting while preserving the approved sales event.

title: Approve a revenue recognition entry
steps: Review proposed recognition date, net amount and policy evidence.
Approve within authority using an independent preparer/approver flow.
Post the entry and inspect its source linkage.
validation: Fixed-precision money, valid currency and an open period are required. Exclude taxes/pass-through sums per approved accounting policy.
system: Post an immutable recognition entry and audit the policy version and approver.
report: Recognised revenue is the sum of approved positive and negative entries by recognition date.
exception: Closed period or self-approval blocks posting. Use a governed adjustment workflow.

title: Create or approve a receivable invoice
steps: Create a draft from verified commercial evidence or import the accounting-system invoice.
Review line items, currency, due date and unique external reference.
Approve within permission and issue through the agreed invoicing source.
validation: Confirm the system of record before build. CRM must not issue a second invoice for an accounting-system invoice.
system: Store invoice status, immutable issued version and ledger linkage; draft edits are versioned.
report: Receivables use invoices, credits and allocated receipts. Invoice amount is not automatically recognised revenue.
exception: Invalid tax/configuration or duplicate invoice reference holds the draft for correction.

title: Import or inspect settled receipt evidence
steps: Import an authorised payment batch or inspect incoming feed records.
Review validation and duplicate exclusions.
Accept valid settled receipts into the unmatched queue.
validation: Unique provider/bank references prevent duplicates. Verify source and settlement status before cash recognition.
system: Store source provenance, settlement date and receipt amount. Quarantine invalid or conflicting rows.
report: Show imported, duplicate, pending and settled totals separately.
exception: A failed retry must reuse the batch/event key and cannot add cash twice.

title: Match a receipt to invoices
steps: Open an unmatched receipt and inspect candidate invoices.
Allocate full or partial amounts across eligible invoices.
Confirm reconciliation and review remaining balances.
validation: Allocated amounts cannot exceed available receipt or open invoice balance. Currency/FX treatment must be explicit.
system: Write allocation rows transactionally and update reconciled balances without changing original receipt evidence.
report: Age only unpaid invoice balances. Keep unapplied cash in suspense.
exception: Ambiguous match requires human review. A match suggestion never posts automatically without the configured authority.

title: Investigate an unmatched payment
steps: Inspect the source reference and eligible commercial records.
Request clarification from the responsible team with minimal necessary data.
Resolve by a verified match, approved correction or suspense classification.
validation: Do not assign arbitrary customer or employee credit to clear the queue. Preserve settlement evidence.
system: Create a reconciliation case with owner and due date; append all decisions.
report: Unmatched cash remains visible in cash totals and suspense, not as unexplained revenue.
exception: Suspected duplicate or fraud is escalated to the designated owner; no automatic write-off.

title: Reconcile sales, revenue and cash totals
steps: Open the reconciliation bridge and inspect differences.
Classify timing, partial payments, reversals or missing records.
Approve the reconciliation or create correction tasks.
validation: Different measurement bases must not be forced to equal. Every difference needs a traceable explanation.
system: Freeze reconciliation version and link outstanding exceptions and source watermarks.
report: Executive reports show certified versus unreconciled components explicitly.
exception: Unexplained material variance blocks period certification according to the approved close policy.

title: Review ageing and assign collection work
steps: Inspect unpaid balances aged from due date.
Open an invoice and assign an eligible follow-up task.
Track promise-to-pay, dispute and actual settlement separately.
validation: Collection contact must obey approved channel and product restrictions. Do not assume WhatsApp is eligible for debt collection.
system: Create accountable tasks linked to invoice balance and retain promise revisions.
report: Measure overdue balance, days outstanding and resolved disputes with the same as-of date.
exception: Disputed invoice is flagged and routed for resolution; a promise-to-pay never counts as received cash.

title: Approve a refund request
steps: Review refund eligibility, evidence and prior refunds.
Approve within limits through an independent approval path.
Track payment execution confirmation separately from approval.
validation: Prevent over-refund and duplicate execution. Require verified beneficiary and current permission.
system: Record approval and external execution reference. Post the appropriate negative receipt/ledger event only from confirmed evidence.
report: Refund reporting uses actual settlement date and linked commercial reversal where applicable.
exception: Approval alone does not mean money was refunded. Failed execution stays pending with an accountable owner.

title: Approve a credit note or revenue reversal
steps: Inspect original entry and correction evidence.
Approve a linked negative or correcting entry within authority.
Review updated balances and downstream incentive impact.
validation: Original entries are never overwritten. Use closed-period policy and an independent approver.
system: Append the adjustment with original ID, reason, policy and effective date.
report: Revised finance totals reconcile to the full ledger; historic reports retain prior versions.
exception: Adjustment beyond authority or into a locked period requires escalation and cannot be backdated silently.

title: Review an incentive calculation
steps: Inspect eligible credited outcomes and scheme rules.
Review exclusions, caps, refunds and transfer attribution.
Approve the calculation for the separate payout process if permitted.
validation: Scheme must be signed, versioned and effective for the period. Credit shares sum to 100%; own submission cannot be self-approved.
system: Freeze calculation inputs and approval, then create payout handoff records.
report: Separate accrued, approved and paid incentives. Staff replacement never inherits prior employee entitlement.
exception: A dispute holds only the affected item where policy allows; record reason and evidence, not an unexplained total edit.

title: Resolve a finance or incentive dispute
steps: Review original rules, evidence and employee claim.
Approve a justified adjustment with an independent decision.
Notify the requester with permitted detail and link the correction.
validation: Do not change historical credit merely because a current Manager requests it. Apply the approved correction policy.
system: Append dispute decision and linked adjustment; retain original calculation.
report: Reports show dispute status, corrected version and impact on entitlement.
exception: Unresolved policy ambiguity goes to the named scheme owner and remains pending.

title: Close a reporting period
steps: Run the close checklist and inspect unresolved differences.
Confirm approved exceptions and independent review.
Certify the period and lock governed finance writes.
validation: Required reconciliations and approvals must pass. Close authority is explicit and cannot be inferred from read access.
system: Create immutable close version, cutoff and audit. Publish certified reporting state.
report: Leadership PDF packs cite the close version. Operational late events remain distinguishable.
exception: Failed checklist blocks close and assigns correction owners; it does not silently ignore material gaps.

title: Request a controlled period reopening
steps: Create a reopening request with impact assessment.
Obtain the independent approval defined in policy.
Apply approved corrections and reclose as a new version.
validation: Never overwrite the original close or distributed report. Default to dated adjustments where policy requires them.
system: Record unlock window, authorised actors, corrections and new close version.
report: Show original and restated versions with the reason for change.
exception: Unapproved reopening remains blocked even for a finance administrator.

title: Review budget and cost performance
steps: Compare approved budget, committed costs and actual costs.
Inspect material variance and source completeness.
Record a finance decision or request a validated correction.
validation: Show margin/ROI only where cost allocation and revenue basis are approved. This module is dependent on a valid cost feed.
system: Store budget versions, actual-source references and finance decisions.
report: Separate proposed, approved, committed and actual amounts.
exception: Missing source data shows incomplete rather than zero expense or inflated margin.

title: Approve finance assumptions in the forecast
steps: Review commercial estimates and finance assumptions.
Concur with the defined basis or return corrections.
Attach finance review status to the executive forecast.
validation: Finance concurrence does not change sales pipeline stages or grant sales access beyond existing scope.
system: Version finance review against the exact forecast submission.
report: CEO sees forecast value and finance-review state separately.
exception: Later forecast edits invalidate prior concurrence when material finance assumptions change.

title: Generate a certified finance pack
steps: Choose the period and close version.
Preview ledger reconciliation and recipient-appropriate detail.
Generate the protected PDF and approved recurring schedule.
validation: Every total uses consistent currency, date basis and source versions. Recheck export scope and audience.
system: Create audited export with certification state, watermark, recipient and expiry.
report: Include recognition, cash, receivable and adjustment bridges with unresolved exceptions.
exception: An open period must be labelled provisional. Reopening generates a new report version.

title: Propose finance approval limits and policies
steps: Draft limits, recognition triggers or incentive policy changes.
Preview affected workflows and conflicts of interest.
Submit for independent approval and Admin publication.
validation: Policy authors cannot unilaterally grant themselves unlimited authority. Unset limits default to no approval.
system: Version approved policy and activate at the agreed date with audit.
report: Transactions retain the policy version used for their decision.
exception: Rejected changes leave existing policy active. Historical entries are never recalculated silently.

title: Capture a source-backed enquiry
steps: Open New entry and complete the approved fields.
Review source and contact-permission evidence.
Submit to validation and inspect the intake reference.
validation: Data Entry cannot choose another vertical outside grants or mark a sales outcome. Required fields depend on product.
system: Store immutable raw intake and validate before creating or linking an opportunity.
report: Count accepted, invalid and duplicate intake separately.
exception: Missing permission can retain a quarantined record for correction but cannot authorise outreach.

title: Upload and map a data file
steps: Upload a permitted file and select the source and vertical.
Map columns and review a preview with validation errors.
Submit the import job and monitor progress.
validation: Enforce size/row limits, safe parsing and required mappings. Formula-like values must not execute in exports.
system: Store file hash, batch ID and row lineage; parse asynchronously with repeat-safe processing.
report: Quality report reconciles submitted rows to accepted, duplicate, invalid and pending rows.
exception: Retry the same batch without duplicating opportunities. A mapping change creates a new reviewed version.

title: Correct rejected intake rows
steps: Filter errors by reason and open the affected row.
Correct permitted fields with evidence.
Revalidate selected rows and inspect the updated disposition.
validation: Do not alter original source history. Accepted sales outcomes cannot be edited through intake correction.
system: Store corrected version and validation result linked to the original row.
report: Measure error rate and correction turnaround without treating retries as new submissions.
exception: Ambiguous source information stays pending and routes back to the source owner.

title: Review a possible duplicate
steps: Inspect only permitted match fields and enquiry context.
Link a genuine repeat intake or preserve a distinct enquiry.
Escalate cross-scope identity decisions to the authorised data steward.
validation: Same phone does not automatically mean duplicate opportunity. No cross-vertical record disclosure.
system: Store reviewed match decision, surviving identifiers and full provenance.
report: Duplicate intake is excluded from fresh-opportunity counts but remains visible in source quality.
exception: Data Entry cannot merge restricted customer identities without a specific steward grant.

title: Publish valid rows to allocation
steps: Inspect validation summary and destination.
Submit or publish the eligible rows within authority.
Receive the canonical IDs and unresolved-row receipt.
validation: Publish only validated, permitted records. Allocation follows eligibility rules, not arbitrary Data Entry ownership.
system: Create/link canonical opportunities and enqueue routing once per intake key.
report: Published count reconciles to linked opportunity IDs and excludes held rows.
exception: Partial failures stay visible and retry independently. No duplicate creation on repeated publish.

title: Maintain source evidence and contact provenance
steps: Open a source record and inspect evidence completeness.
Submit a correction or renewed source document.
Flag invalid source evidence for the accountable owner.
validation: Source approval is a distinct permission. Data Entry cannot invent customer permission or override suppression.
system: Version provenance and notify the policy/source owner about missing evidence.
report: Report source completeness and held batches by cause.
exception: Source suspension holds dependent new outreach until an approved resolution.

title: Export an intake quality report
steps: Select period and source filters.
Inspect batch-to-row reconciliation.
Generate a scoped PDF and correction worklist.
validation: Report exposes only permitted intake data and minimal customer identifiers.
system: Generate versioned export with cutoff, evidence status and download audit.
report: Data-entry performance is data quality and timeliness, not the associates sales outcomes.
exception: A batch still processing is labelled incomplete and not counted as fully accepted.

title: Request a new employee account
steps: Create the employee lifecycle request with approved placement.
Attach role, supervisor, employment dates and required training.
Submit for approvals and Super Admin provisioning.
validation: HR cannot issue the role grant directly. Resolve duplicate employee identity through an audited process.
system: Create employment episode and provisioning request; notify required approvers.
report: Track readiness, pending approvals and start-date risk.
exception: Incomplete placement leaves access pending, never a default company-wide dashboard.

title: Request an effective-dated team transfer
steps: Capture the approved destination and reporting path.
Review lead, task, target and review ownership impact.
Submit the dated move for Super Admin activation.
validation: Permanent employee identity stays unchanged. Current access ends at the change boundary; past facts are preserved.
system: Record lifecycle approval and handoff checklist with accountable owners.
report: HR reports planned versus completed moves and unresolved handoff items.
exception: A pending transfer does not expose the destination interface or move leads early.

title: Request a promotion with retained career history
steps: Record promotion approvals and new scope.
Specify treatment of old leads and ongoing reviews.
Submit and verify activation through the lifecycle status.
validation: Old role permissions end by default. Career reports remain available as read-only history within the new interface.
system: Create new assignment interval and preserve prior role snapshots and performance identity.
report: Promotion does not transfer past personal sales into new team performance.
exception: Dual duties require explicit dated grants; they are never inferred from the promotion.

title: Coordinate an employee exit
steps: Record authorised exit and exact effective time.
Assign handoff owners for leads, tasks, reports and approvals.
Confirm Admin revocation and close the exit checklist.
validation: Replacement must receive a new employee/account identity. Record retention follows the approved policy.
system: Schedule account disable and job/schedule ownership review. Preserve immutable history.
report: Exit checklist tracks operational completion without copying the leavers personal performance to another person.
exception: Urgent suspension routes immediately to Admin; business work goes to an accountable holding queue if no recipient exists.

title: Record leave and allocation availability
steps: Record approved leave or availability dates.
Notify the supervisor of open work requiring coverage.
Confirm effective availability used by routing.
validation: HR visibility excludes unnecessary medical/private details from sales supervisors. Leave approval is a named policy.
system: Publish minimal availability flags and create coverage reminders.
report: Capacity reports use available eligible staff; performance prorating follows the signed target policy.
exception: Leave does not automatically transfer every lead. Supervisor must confirm the required handoff.

title: Track probation, training and review completion
steps: Inspect upcoming milestones and overdue training/reviews.
Assign reminders and request supervisor evidence.
Record completion or route an extension/role decision for approval.
validation: Completion of training alone does not grant broader access. HR sees approved summaries, not unrestricted customer recordings.
system: Store milestone evidence, reviewer and lifecycle follow-up request.
report: Track completion rates using eligible employee cohorts and explicit exclusions.
exception: Expired intern grants trigger access review, not automatic permanent-role conversion.

title: Prepare a people operations pack
